decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - INFORMATIVE  --  The detached outbuilding hereby approved shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family dwellinghouse known as 127 Bedfont Close and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling and should not include toilet, bathroom or kitchen facilities).
description: Change of use from ancillary garage to ancillary playroom at rear of semi-detached single dwellinghouse and extension of existing garage to bring ancillary playroom within curtilage of the house
